segments.text: At the Dunphy house, Claire finds what looks like a cigarette burn on the couch. None of the children admits to smoking, so Phil makes a big announcement: if no one tells the truth, Christmas is canceled.

segments.text: Claire thinks he’s gone too far, but Phil refuses to back down. They remove the tree and all the decorations, hoping one of the kids will confess. Haley, Alex, and Luke keep blaming one another, but no one admits anything.

segments.text: Eventually, Alex says she did it. Phil and Claire bring Christmas back, although they still punish her for smoking and lying. Later, sunlight shines through a glass ornament and starts burning the couch in the exact same place.

segments.text: After talking to Cameron, Jay realizes that he can’t simply recreate the Christmases he had with his old family. He needs to make new memories with Gloria and Manny. Manny also understands why Jay cares so much about his old traditions.

segments.text: Mitchell and Cameron take Lily to the mall for her first picture with Santa. Mitchell complains that the Santa is too thin, and the man gets fired. Feeling guilty, they invite him home for dinner.
